title: US billion-dollar weather disasters per year, then vs now

source.name: U.S. Billion-Dollar Weather and Climate Disasters
source.publisher: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI)

notes: NOAA NCEI's cost-of-disasters database tracks all billion-dollar weather and climate disaster types (not hurricanes alone). The 1980s annual average was roughly 3 events/year; the 2019-2023 annual average was over 20/year. Figures approximate, rounded.
